body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> WesternDigital(www.wdc.com) introduced 'WD TV Live Hub', settop box which iscombined internet and network, at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
When you connect 'WD TV Live Hub' connected with internet with HD TV, streaming service such as Netflix and YouTube and HD movie stored at its own storage 1TB are available.
